## Background

The iris dataset contains measurements of flowers from three species: setosa, versicolor, and virginica. It is available as an example dataset in R.

In this report, I explore how petal length varies between the three species.

## Research question

How does petal length vary between the three iris species?

## Data

The dataset contains 150 observations, with 50 flowers from each species. Petal length is measured in centimetres.
